title: AI Code Review on Every Pull Request in One File
description:
Want AI to review every pull request for you? One YAML file does it! 🤖

✅ Trigger a workflow when a pull request opens
✅ Add the Claude action with your key as a secret
✅ Tell it what to check and push

Day 5 of AI Debugging. Next up: Day 6, Catch Hallucinated APIs and Packages.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to debug with AI the right way.

#shorts #coding #programming #ai #codereview #github
comment: Bugs or style: what should AI check first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: keep the prompt short and specific, like Review this PR for bugs, so every review stays focused.
